stories.title: Explainability UI Rendering in Chat Messages
stories.description: Update frontend MessageBubble and ChatWindow components to render explainability fields (source, meaning, limitations) in a structured and readable format within chat responses, ensuring sanitization and compatibility with markdown rendering.

stories.title: LLM Prompt Integration for Explainability
stories.description: Modify prompt construction to ensure explainability objects are incorporated into LLM responses in a consistent narrative format, preserving structured fields while enabling conversational clarity.

stories.title: Explainability Fallback and Missing Data Handling
stories.description: Implement safeguards in the explainability builder to handle missing or partial data by populating default limitations and disclaimers, ensuring no evaluation signal is returned without explainability context.
